1. **set function** (lines 11-25): Creates intermediate objects if they don't exist (`obj[seg] = obj[seg] || {}`)
2. **get function** (lines 36-47): Returns undefined if any intermediate property doesn't exist (`if (!obj[seg]) return;`)
3. **delete function** (lines 58-69): Returns early if any intermediate property doesn't exist (`if (!obj[seg]) return;`)
